the CL dissipation can be measured without the need for local measurements of CL dynamics, or knowledge of the equilibrium CA, by using a frequency sweep to measure the amplitude of the CL motion.
the rate of CL dissipation can be determined from the resonant frequency of the CL, and that the rate of dissipation can be used to estimate the CA.
